Wind Comic v13.18 

 
 One sentence in. A finished short-form drama out — script, cast, storyboards, voiceover, timeline, mp4. 
 Multi-agent AI studio · reusable characters · novel→season splitting · director's control room · real-time collab · bring-your-own LLM.

---

 MiniMax H3 video-generation API — MetaSota (秘塔科技). ¥0.09/s at 768P, ¥0.15/s at 2K · native 2K with synced audio · OpenAI-compatible API · ComfyUI supported · no GPU to deploy. 🎁 Sign up through the wind-comic link for bonus credits and a partner discount. 
 
 
 

---

 

 ✨ Why Wind Comic?

Most "AI video" tools give you a 5-second clip from a one-line prompt. Wind Comic gives you a finished short-form drama — script, character bible, multi-shot storyboards, voice-acted lines, BGM, mouth-synced characters (indicative 2D lip bar out of the box; photorealistic face-level lip-sync via BYO wav2lip/SadTalker/MuseTalk or Kling), and a final mp4 — from the same single line.

It works because it doesn't try to be one giant model. It's an honest multi-agent pipeline where each role (Writer, Director, Producer, Character Designer, Storyboard Artist, Cameo Locker, Lipsync, Editor) is a specialist that hands off with strict consistency contracts. Plus a real-time multiplayer timeline to edit with your team like Figma for film.

 

---

 🏗 Architecture

Three views of the same engine. Open on GitHub to watch them animate — flowing dashes trace live data & control paths, traveling dots are data packets moving through the pipeline.

 

 System architecture — five layers, top to bottom. The Director threads control across the seven pipeline agents (eight roles including the Director); the LLM gateway falls back DeepSeek → MiniMax with zero code change; 12+ media engines plug in behind one router; everything lands on a dual-driver (SQLite ⇄ PostgreSQL) platform. 

 

 Sequence — the lifecycle of one idea → film request, time flowing down. Two signature beats: the Vision-Audit retry loop (auto-regenerate any shot scoring < 70) and the multi-engine race (Seedance / Kling / Veo / Vidu — first good clip wins). 

 

 Data flow — the artifact refinery. One line of text is refined stage-by-stage ( TEXT → JSON → PNG → IMG → MP4 ); every artifact is persisted to the dual-driver DB + asset store and is independently reusable, so any stage can be re-run in isolation. 

 🎞️ Diagrams are animated SVG, authored as code in assets/diagrams/ — crisp at any zoom, versioned with the source. (Animation renders on GitHub; the ModelScope mirror shows static PNG.) 

---

 🆕 New in v13.0 — the frame you set is the frame you get

v13.0 consolidates v12.461 – v12.473 (13 releases, 2026-09-30 → 10-09). One pattern ran through most of them: settings that looked like they worked but had no code reading them , and engine requests that looked like they succeeded but sent the wrong thing .

 Aspect ratio, end to end (v12.464, 467, 468, 470 – 473) — until v12.467 only full-film generation read the project's aspect ratio. Regenerating a single shot, self-healing retakes, segment retake, 4K re-render, recomposing after a chat edit, scene-image regeneration and the ad workshop each fell back to their own 16:9 or 9:16, so a 9:16 project could get a landscape shot back. They now all read projects.aspect through one shared parser . Prompt templates no longer hard-code --ar 16:9 (a vertical project used to send Midjourney both --ar 16:9 and --ar 9:16 ); Midjourney parameters are moved to the end and appear once, and non-Midjourney image engines and the video engines receive plain text. The create page no longer offers 2.35:1, which no video engine we ship can output; the ad workshop's aspect is now selectable and defaults to the project's.

 Settings that finally have a reader (v12.464, 466, 469, 473) — the format bar's color space now goes into storyboard prompts, its safe-area toggle drives the 9:16 overlay, and its aspect is a read-only display of the project's real aspect instead of a second, dead copy. The short-video planner dropped the resolution / frame-rate / upscaling / interpolation / motion-strength controls that nothing read (the defaults claimed 8K, 4× upscale and interpolation), and its aspect choice now carries over to the create page.

 Director's console, finished (v12.462, 463, 465) — add, remove and rename actors; the camera can tilt , and "aim at subjects" points a raised camera at the actors; the layout sketch re-renders when the blocking changes, and shots generated from the old blocking are marked stale. The sketch goes only to engines that compose from it (fal Kontext, Seedream; Midjourney as an opt-in) — never to MiniMax, whose reference input is portrait-only. The full walkthrough — real WebGL (software-rendered in CI) and real MediaPipe pose inference — now runs in CI.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Camera raised to 2.6 m, then aim at subjects : it tilts 19° down and the console now calls it a high-angle shot. The 3D view, the flat preview, the prompt line and the layout sketch all use this one camera. 
 Same camera, flat preview: the horizon sits high in the frame because the lens points down. Before v12.465 a raised camera still looked level, while the prompt already said "high angle".

install.title: Quick start
install.html:
Zero-key trial (one command, no API key needed)
docker run -p 3100:3100 -v wind-comic-demo:/app/data \
  -e MOCK_ENGINES=1 -e JWT_SECRET=demo-only-not-for-production -e DEMO_PASSWORD=wind-comic-demo \
  ghcr.io/chrischen667788/wind-comic:latest

Then open http://localhost:3100 and sign in as demo@qfmanju.ai / wind-comic-demo. No clone, no npm install, no local build. (Without DEMO_PASSWORD the demo account gets a random password that is printed once in docker logs, and sign-up needs an invite code by default.) For a ready-made sample project, click 「导入演示工程《雨夜信号》」 on the Projects page.

Prefer compose (same thing, same demo login):

docker compose -f docker-compose.demo.yml up

⚠️ Honest note: demo mode runs the deterministic mock engines (MOCK_ENGINES=1 — SVG storyboards, solid-colour clips, sine-wave audio). It demonstrates the pipeline and the product shape, and is not representative of real generation quality. Every artifact is labelled as mock — passing a placeholder off as a finished film is exactly the thing this project keeps hunting down. Add a single API key to switch to real engines.

Self-host on a NAS / home server (Docker Compose)

A verified single-box setup lives in deploy/: docker-compose.yml + .env.example. Full walkthrough, Synology notes and troubleshooting: docs/DEPLOYMENT.md → Docker 与 NAS 自托管.

mkdir -p wind-comic && cd wind-comic
curl -fsSLO https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChrisChen667788/wind-comic/main/deploy/docker-compose.yml
curl -fsSL  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChrisChen667788/wind-comic/main/deploy/.env.example -o .env
# edit .env: JWT_SECRET=$(openssl rand -hex 32), DEMO_PASSWORD=<your password>
mkdir -p data && sudo chown -R 1001:1001 data   # the container runs as uid/gid 1001
docker compose up -d
curl http://localhost:3100/api/health           # {"ok":true,"checks":{"db":"ok","auth":"ok"}}

Hardware (measured on the v13.6 image)
Architecture linux/amd64 or linux/arm64 — no 32-bit ARM. No GPU needed (all generation is via APIs; ffmpeg runs on CPU).
CPU 2 cores work; more cores only make the final compose faster (6-shot 30 s film at 720p: ~16 s on 2 cores, ~10 s on 4).
Memory Idle 70–120 MB. Composing a 6-shot, 30 s film (xfade + CJK subtitles + loudness normalisation) peaks at ≈ 0.95 GB at 720p and ≈ 1.75 GB at 1080×1920 for the whole container. Below that the compose is OOM-killed (768 MB killed 720p; 1 GB killed vertical 1080p). Measured floor: 1 GB / 2 GB — give the container ≥ 1.5 GB for 720p, ≥ 2.5 GB for vertical 1080p.
Disk Image ~830 MB download, ~3 GB unpacked; plus room for assets and films under data/ (10 GB+ is comfortable).

Home page loads but you can't log in? From v13.11 the login page says what is misconfigured and how to fix it (the API returns 503 with the reason below; before that it was a bare 500). docker logs wind-comic has the matching line:

Login page says (reason) Log line Cause Fix
服务端数据库打不开 — database can't be opened (db_unavailable) [db] 数据库打不开(SQLITE_CANTOPEN: unable to open database file) data/ is owned by your NAS user (Synology: 1026:100), the container runs as 1001:1001 sudo chown -R 1001:1001 data, or use a named volume instead of ./data; then restart the container
服务端没配置 JWT_SECRET — not set (jwt_secret_missing) [auth] JWT_SECRET 未设置 JWT_SECRET not set set it (openssl rand -hex 32) and recreate the container
服务端没配置 JWT_SECRET — public placeholder (jwt_secret_weak) [auth] JWT_SECRET 是公开占位/弱默认值 JWT_SECRET is a placeholder copied from an example same — generate a real one
服务端连不上数据库(PostgreSQL)— can't reach Postgres (db_unreachable, only with DB_DRIVER=pg, since v13.12) [db] PostgreSQL 连不上或没配好(ECONNREFUSED) (or 28P01 wrong password, 3D000 no such database, database_url_missing, …) DATABASE_URL wrong or unset, Postgres not running or not reachable from the container (localhost inside a container is the container itself), wrong user / password / database name fix DATABASE_URL or start Postgres; recreate the container if you changed env vars

The container health check probes /api/health (since v13.6; DB read/write + JWT key, same reason codes as above), so all of these show up as unhealthy instead of a green container that cannot log anyone in. With PIPELINE_QUEUE=1 an unopenable database no longer takes the whole site down (before v13.11 even the home page returned 500).

First login & first creation: the first account is demo@qfmanju.ai with your DEMO_PASSWORD (set it later and restart — the password is rotated to match). Sign-up needs an invite code unless you set BETA_INVITE_REQUIRED=false (only on a network you trust). New accounts are on the free tier with a ¥5 monthly budget, which blocks a full real-engine film (pre-checked at ¥11.6–18.8 for the default 8 shots, depending on the video engine) — raise 「月预算 ¥」 at /dashboard/usage (saved when the field loses focus). Other devices on your LAN can open plain http://<NAS-IP>:3100 directly — since v13.5 the session cookie only carries Secure when the request is HTTPS (COOKIE_SECURE=auto, the default). Plain HTTP sends the session token unencrypted, so keep that to a network you trust; from the Internet, put it behind HTTPS (Caddy / Traefik / nginx with X-Forwarded-Proto). Details: docs/DEPLOYMENT.md → 会话 Cookie 与 HTTPS.

Full setup (real engines)
# 1. clone + install
git clone https://github.com/ChrisChen667788/wind-comic.git
#    in mainland China, clone the AtomGit mirror instead (LFS videos included):
#    git clone https://atomgit.com/ChrisChen667788/wind-comic.git
cd wind-comic
npm install

# 2. configure (3 mandatory lines, see docs/llm-providers.md for swaps)
cp .env.example .env.local
# Edit .env.local:
#   OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...
#   OPENAI_BASE_URL=https://api.openai.com/v1     # or any compat provider
#   OPENAI_MODEL=gpt-4o                            # or claude-opus-4 via OpenRouter, etc.

# 3. run
npm run dev                # Next.js on :3000
# Optional second terminal for real-time collab:
npm run dev:ws             # Yjs WebSocket server on :1234

# 4. open http://localhost:3000 and create your first short film

Minimum LLM: any model ≥24B parameters that responds in JSON. We've tested gpt-4o, Claude Opus 4, DeepSeek-r1, Qwen-Max, MiniMax-M2, GLM-4.5, Kimi-K2.

features.title: Highlights · The features competitors don't have
features.html:
1. Multi-agent pipeline, not one black-box model

Director plans the story → Writer drafts dialogue under McKee structure → Style Bible Frame locks the look → Character Designer extracts an 8-dimension DNA signature of each character → Storyboard renders with Vision Audit (auto-regen on <70 score) → Video producer races multiple engines (Minimax / Veo / Kling) → Editor cuts j/l-cut on emotional beats and burns CJK subtitles.

2. The visual coherence trick — Style Bible Frame (v2.20)

We render one canonical "key art" frame from the Director's plan, then pass it as the first --sref of every subsequent storyboard render. Net effect: all 6 shots feel like they came from the same show, not 6 random Midjourney runs. (Most competitors only carry a 2-frame rolling chain — shot 6 doesn't know what shot 1 looked like.)

3. 9:16 by default + 12 short-drama trope templates (v2.20 P0.2)

Writer prompt detects 短剧/漫剧 genres and switches to vertical canvas + injects proven hook patterns (重生回到 N 年前 · 当街掌掴 + 秘密身份 · 系统提示音突响 · etc). McKee 3-act still backs it; tropes are the surface.

4. Real CJK subtitle burning (v2.22)

The garbled-Chinese-text-in-AI-video problem solved properly: we strip dialogue text from the video prompt (so the model doesn't try to draw garbled glyphs) + add aggressive negatives (--no text --no chinese --no captions) + post-bake real subtitles with ffmpeg subtitles filter using a system CJK font (PingFang / Noto Sans CJK).

5. Character consistency = cref + sref + 8-dim DNA + Cameo Vision Retry (v2.21 P1.2)

Beyond reference image hacks, we run each character's turnaround sheet through Vision LLM to extract structured features (eye shape / jaw angle / hair style / signature outfit etc.), then inject as natural-language anchor into every shot prompt. Combined with cameo-vision-retry: if a shot's character match scores <75, we auto-regen with boosted cw.

6. Logic-Pro-style multi-track timeline with real-time collab (v3.1.1–v3.1.3)
  • 3 tracks: shots / BGM / subtitle
  • Real BGM waveform decoded via Web Audio API (not procedural)
  • Drag-to-retime + edge handles to resize duration
  • Auto-snap to neighbors within 0.4s threshold + hard-clamp on overlap
  • Real-time multiplayer: Yjs awareness paints other users' cursors live, presence avatars show which tab each collaborator is in, Y.Map locks prevent two people editing the same segment
  • Project invites with viewer/commenter/editor role gating
7. Lipsync that actually works (zh / en; needs a public video URL + audio ≥ 2s)

Kling lip-sync API for talking heads, with Sync.so and Hailuo as auto-fallback. The pipeline strips dialogue from the prompt so the model only generates lip motion; we then sync the lips to the TTS audio in post. Real-machine limits: dialogue audio must be ≥ 2 seconds and the source video must be reachable at a public URL; ja/ko/ru currently degrade to no lip-sync (honest skip, surfaced in the engine-weather panel).

8. Conflict / reversal / cliffhanger pacing audit — v2 (v2.21 P1.1 → v12.275)

After Writer finishes, we score each shot 0-10 on a Chinese-conflict-word dictionary + detect emotional polarity reversals + cliffhanger keywords.

v12.275 turned scoring into diagnosis. An average score hides the difference between a story that builds and one that peaks in shot 1 — [1,2,4,9] and [9,4,2,1] both average 4. So v2 adds four things the average cannot see:

  • Conflict-curve shape — least-squares slope + peak position + peak prominence, classified as escalating / flat / front-loaded / no-climax.
  • Drag-segment localisation — names the exact shot range (e.g. "shots 3–5") where conflict flatlines, instead of reporting one global number.
  • Opening density — the first third is audited separately, because completion rate is decided there.
  • Duration rhythm — v1 never looked at duration; v2 flags both uniform-length monotony and long-take pile-ups.

Every finding points at the shots to change. All pure functions over existing fields — no extra LLM calls, no added cost.

9. Bring Your Own LLM (v3.1.3)

Every text-LLM call (Director / Writer / Vision / Audit) goes through one OpenAI-compatible chat/completions endpoint. Want to swap to DeepSeek-r1 / GPT-4o / Claude (via OpenRouter) / Qwen-Max / local Ollama? Edit 3 lines in .env. Zero code change. See docs/llm-providers.md for the full matrix.

10. 7041 tests, TypeScript strict, no fake "coming soon"s

Every feature listed above is in main, type-checked, unit-tested, and visible at /projects/[id] if you npm install && npm run dev right now.
